card.name: Broken bullet and symbol characters
card.fires_on: Garbled or partial special characters, such as a bullet or dagger symbol that has broken into stray bytes, at the start of a list item or table footnote mark. Also seen on odd accented letters in non-English text.

modes.label: Broken bullet in lists
modes.description: A damaged bullet symbol that opens an item in a list of preparation or inspection steps.

modes.label: Stray symbol in tables
modes.description: A garbled footnote or marker character beside a drug name or dose row in an interaction or dosing table.

modes.label: Odd letters in foreign text
modes.description: A rare accented or diacritic character inside non-English words.

card.plain: It fires on garbled symbol characters, mostly broken bullets and table marks in label text.
